## Instruction manuals match the new contract: trie is a context layer with… — 2026-07-25 (parent af75dd18cb9b)

All patch-family docstrings in `TrieTools` and the opencode `_render_opencode_*` renderers have been reframed around the context-layer contract: agents edit source natively, trie guarantees the intent record. The "model generates the change at apply" language is gone. Affected symbols:

- `TrieTools.patch`, `batch_patch`, `create_symbol`, `delete_symbol`, `rename_symbol`, `preview` — docstrings now say "record why, you edit the code"
- `_render_opencode_patch`, `_render_opencode_batch_patch`, `_render_opencode_create_symbol`, `_render_opencode_delete_symbol`, `_render_opencode_rename_symbol` — tool descriptions updated to match

`README.md` was rewritten as an index of meaning and intent (two-indexes framing, commit-loop diagram, accurate commands); the prior README is preserved at `docs/readme_grand.md`. `trie/data/TRIE.md` intro was updated to describe trie as the project's context layer with two indexes and the intent gate.
